correction.text: Kilwa Kisiwani and its mainland (the page names no boundary)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 957-1513: Kilwa Kisiwani and its mainland shore. The page gives no area, boundary or mainland holding; at its zenith the sultanate 'owned or claimed overlordship' over the island-states of Mombasa, Pemba, Zanzibar, Mafia, Comoro and Mozambique, which the ledger draws as vassal tint, not as territory. Infobox start 957 (the text says the history 'begins around 960-1000 AD', 'founded in the 10th century' by legend).

region.text: Kilwa Kisiwani and its mainland (the page names no boundary)

ledger.note: 957: Ali ibn al-Hassan Shirazi founds the sultanate of Kilwa. Infobox 'Established: 957'; 'According to the legend, it was founded in the 10th century by Ali ibn al-Hassan Shirazi, a Persian prince of Shiraz'; 'The history of the Kilwa Sultanate begins around 960-1000 AD'.
c. 1277: the Mahdali dynasty of Yemeni Arabs replaces the Shirazi. 'End of Persian Shirazi dynasty c. 1277, beginning of Mahdali dynasty of Yemeni Arab'; same state, same colour.

region.text: Mombasa, listed among the island-states Kilwa claimed

ledger.note: Early 14th century: Mombasa becomes a dependency of Kilwa. Mombasa page: 'It was a part of the Kilwa Sultanate from approximately the early 14th century until the dissolution of the sultanate in 1513' (infobox 'Kilwa Sultanate 1300-1513'); the Kilwa page lists Mombasa among the island-states it 'owned or claimed overlordship' over at its 15th-century zenith. [Reviewer af-05, 2026-10-19: year moved from the 1400 placeholder to the Mombasa page's 1300, confidence 1 to 2.]

region.text: the island-states of Pemba, Zanzibar, Mafia, Comoro and Mozambique, over which the Kilwa Sultanate 'owned or claimed overlordship' at its 15th-century zenith (Mafia and Mozambique Island located by the researcher)

ledger.note: 15th century: Kilwa's island dependencies. 'At the zenith of its power in the 15th century, the Kilwa Sultanate owned or claimed overlordship' over 'the island-states of Mombasa, Pemba, Zanzibar, Mafia, Comoro, and Mozambique'. The page gives no year inside the century; 1400 is a placeholder for its start.
c. 1495: the Mahdali line ends. 'End of Mahdali dynasty c. 1495, beginning of a series of usurpers and Portuguese puppets.'

region.text: Mombasa, listed among the island-states Kilwa claimed

ledger.note: 1502: Mombasa becomes independent of Kilwa. 'In 1502, the sultanate became independent from Kilwa Kisiwani and was renamed Mvita or Manbasa' (the same page's infobox keeps Mombasa in the Kilwa Sultanate to 1513).

region.text: Kilwa Kisiwani and its mainland (the page names no boundary)

ledger.note: 1505: Almeida's fleet takes Kilwa and builds Fort Santiago. 'It was in 1505 that Francisco de Almeida brought his fleet into the harbor of Kilwa'; 'The Portuguese erected a fortress (Fort Santiago) on Kilwa and left a garrison behind'. A Portuguese-chosen sultan follows (Micante, 1506) in the pages' account of 'usurpers and Portuguese puppets'.

ledger.note: 1505: the island dependencies slip away with the Portuguese conquest. The page names no date for their loss; the Portuguese fort at Kilwa and the factory and fort at Sofala (1505) end the overlordship in practice. Reading of the researcher, hence confidence 2.

ledger.note: 1513: the sultanate is disestablished (infobox 'Disestablished: 1513') and the land passes to the Portuguese Empire.

region.text: Kilwa Kisiwani and its mainland (the page names no boundary)

ledger.note: 1513: the Kilwa Sultanate ends. Infobox 'Disestablished: 1513', 'Succeeded by Portuguese Empire / Sultanate of Zanzibar'. The pages opened give no event for 1513 itself; the Portuguese garrison dates from 1505.

wars.name: Portuguese conquest of Kilwa

zones.text: Kilwa Kisiwani and its mainland (the page names no boundary)

wars.outcome: Portuguese victory: Almeida's fleet entered the harbour in 1505, Fort Santiago was built and a garrison left; by late 1506 the Portuguese were convening 'competing sultans Micante and Hussein'. The sultanate is disestablished in 1513.
wars.note: Emir Ibrahim had signed a treaty in 1502 after the Fourth Armada of Vasco da Gama 'extorted a sizeable tribute'.

certainty.note: An island city-state with claimed dependencies: no boundary or survey on the page.

sources.note: Mombasa history: Portuguese 1593-1698, 1631 revolt, 1698 Omani capture, Mazrui independence 1746, British protectorate 1824-1826, annexation by Said 24 June 1837, 1887 relinquished to the British East Africa Association, 1895.

sources.title: Kilwa Sultanate
sources.note: Infobox 957-1513; Shirazi to Mahdali c. 1277, Mahdali end c. 1495; the 15th-century overlordship of Mombasa, Pemba, Zanzibar, Mafia, Comoro, Mozambique; Portuguese 1497-1506, Fort Santiago 1505.

notes:
New state (Cliopatria has no Kilwa row), from one page (Kilwa Sultanate) plus the Mombasa page for 1502. Infobox 957-1513; legend and text give the 10th century.

Not on the page and therefore not recorded: Mombasa as a Kilwa possession from 1300 (the Mombasa page's infobox says so; the Kilwa page does not mention it), the dates of the Great Mosque and Husuni Kubwa, the abandonment of Kilwa Kisiwani, Kilwa Kivinje and the later Omani and German holdings. The 1400 placeholder year for the dependencies is flagged by confidence 1; a gap-filler should open 'Kilwa Kisiwani' or a Swahili-coast history for the 15th-century dates. The Kilwa page ends the sultanate in 1513 although its dated lines stop in 1506. The 1505 'vassal_end' of the dependencies is the researcher's reading.

Counterparts needing dossiers: portuguese-empire (a dossier file exists in polities/; the Portuguese coast, Sofala and Mozambique Island are for it), the Mombasa of 1502-1589 (see sultanate-of-mombasa notes), a Comoros state (none). The island zone uses a 30 km radius at Mafia (7.9 S, 39.78 E) and Mozambique Island (15.03 S, 40.74 E), the researcher's coordinates; gazetteer names needed: Mafia Island, Ilha de Mocambique, Kilwa Kisiwani (exists as Kilwa).

Reviewer af-05 (2026-10-19): the Mombasa vassal_start is now dated 1300 from the Mombasa page ('a part of the Kilwa Sultanate from approximately the early 14th century'; infobox 'Kilwa Sultanate 1300-1513'), at confidence 2.
